title: 跨座式單軌導梁
summary: 本課聚焦跨座導梁的彎扭變形幾何與車輛動態介面。從導梁彎曲的量級檢查建立物理或資訊邊界，接著把導梁伸縮與支承活動與導梁波長與行車激振連成可驗證的介面，最後以彎扭溫度整合案例整理證據。學徒逐一完成機制推導、數值算例、失效辨識及參數實驗，所有練習限定在離線模型或隔離教具，保留假設與量測的不確定度。
summaryEn: This course studies bending, torsion, geometry and vehicle dynamics of straddle-monorail beams. Start with scale check of guideway bending to define physical or information boundaries, connect thermal movement and support travel with guideway wavelength and running excitation as verifiable interfaces, and organize evidence through combined bending, torsion and temperature cases. Each unit develops a mechanism, numerical example, failure diagnosis and parameter experiment in an offline model or isolated teaching rig, retaining assumptions and measurement uncertainty.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

stages.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查與偏心輪載與導梁扭轉
stages.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending & Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」與「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Scale check of guideway bending" and "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」如何影響跨座式單軌導梁的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Scale check of guideway bending” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 以簡支跨中力建立導梁撓度基準，觀察跨度三次方對變形的影響。真實輪載分布和支承條件另列，避免將單一教學梁當成整條導梁驗收。簡支梁跨中集中荷載的撓度隨跨度三次方增加，與彎曲剛度成反比。跨座導梁的車輛輪載並非真正集中於單點，支承與扭轉也會參與；概念梁模型適合量級檢查，但不能直接作為完整導梁的行車驗收。解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity. Retain real wheel distribution and supports as separate conditions rather than accepting a full guideway through one beam model. Midspan deflection of a simply supported beam under a central point load scales with span cubed and inversely with flexural rigidity. Monorail wheel loads are distributed and involve supports and torsion. The beam model is useful for scale checks, not complete guideway acceptance. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Scale check of guideway bending” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Scale check of guideway bending”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查
knowledge.text: 以簡支跨中力建立導梁撓度基準，觀察跨度三次方對變形的影響。真實輪載分布和支承條件另列，避免將單一教學梁當成整條導梁驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity. Retain real wheel distribution and supports as separate conditions rather than accepting a full guideway through one beam model.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 任務延伸｜遊戲交班延伸：先界定介面
knowledge.titleEn: Mission extension | Campaign transfer: define interfaces first
knowledge.text:
本課「跨座式單軌導梁」的「導梁彎曲的量級檢查：機制與系統路徑」是這項延伸任務的檢核點。 畫出車輛、軌道、牽引供電、號誌與旅客的介面，在每條箭頭旁寫量、單位、正方向與資料版本。再打開「列車性能與時刻表室」，比較哪一個介面可類比、哪一個不可類比；不可因為畫面相似就共用數值參數。

需留下的證據：提交一張介面圖與版本一致的速度、時間、位置、負載及控制紀錄的欄位樣本；將假設值、來源值與本次實測值分欄。

驗證與交接：每個介面至少有一個可核對量；提出一項能讓模型失效的邊界改變，而不是只重述公式。
knowledge.textEn:
The checkpoint is “Scale check of guideway bending: mechanism and system paths” in “Straddle-monorail guideway beams”. Draw the vehicle, track, traction, signaling and passenger interfaces; label quantities, units, sign conventions and data revisions on each arrow. Open “Train performance and timetable room” and identify which interfaces transfer and which do not. Similar-looking scenes do not justify shared numerical parameters.

Evidence to retain: Submit an interface diagram and sample fields for version-aligned speed, time, position, load and control records, separating assumed, sourced and newly measured values.

Verification and handover: Each interface has a checkable quantity. Identify one boundary change that invalidates the model instead of merely repeating a formula.

quiz.question: 關於「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Scale check of guideway bending" is correct?
options: 跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍
以簡支跨中力建立導梁撓度基準，觀察跨度三次方對變形的影響。
導梁中心線沒有明顯下沉就表示不可能發生扭轉
optionsEn: Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection.
Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity.
Little guideway-centreline settlement proves that torsion cannot occur.
quiz.explanation: 以簡支跨中力建立導梁撓度基準，觀察跨度三次方對變形的影響。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Use a simply supported central-load beam as a deflection reference and examine cubic span sensitivity. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Scale check of guideway bending” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。公式 y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000，代入得 y=0.761905 mm。邊界：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4. Formula y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000 gives y=0.761905 mm. Boundary: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。公式 y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000，代入得 y=0.761905 mm。邊界：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4. Formula y=P*L**3/(48*E*I)*1000 gives y=0.761905 mm. Boundary: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Scale check of guideway bending", which statement holds?
options: 量不到熱伸長就表示構件完全沒有熱應力
任何兩個誤差都可以不問相關性直接平方和開根號
原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。
optionsEn: No measured thermal expansion means that a member has no thermal stress.
Any two errors can be combined by root-sum-square without considering correlation.
Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想教學輸入：跨中集中力 P=80000 N；簡支跨度 L=20 m；彈性模數 E=3.5e+10 Pa；截面慣性矩 I=0.5 m4。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical teaching inputs: central point load P=80000 N; simply supported span L=20 m; Young modulus E=3.5e+10 Pa; second moment of area I=0.5 m4. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Scale check of guideway bending” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。以「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. For scale check of guideway bending, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：只把簡支跨度 L 從 20 改成 22 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.761905 變為 1.0141 mm。先說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Change only simply supported span L from 20 to 22 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.761905 to 1.0141 mm. Explain the causal direction for scale check of guideway bending, check that the stated boundary still holds, and submit the calculation plus one observation that could refute the explanation.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。以「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」為驗證目標，先寫出預期變化方向及可分辨的替代原因，再保存原始讀值、單位、校正版本與時間窗。只有比較同一系統邊界的資料，才判定殘差是否支持這項機制。
knowledge.textEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. For scale check of guideway bending, state the expected direction and distinguishable alternative causes before collecting data. Retain raw readings, units, calibration version and observation window. Compare evidence within the same system boundary before deciding whether the residual supports this mechanism.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 只把簡支跨度 L 從 20 改成 22 m（增加百分之十），其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.761905 變為 1.0141 mm。先說明「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」中變化的因果方向，再檢查適用邊界是否仍成立，提交計算與一個可反駁此解釋的觀測。
knowledge.textEn: Change only simply supported span L from 20 to 22 m (increase by ten percent), holding other inputs fixed. Recalculate 0.761905 to 1.0141 mm. quiz.question: 要驗證「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Scale check of guideway bending"?
options: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
結構越硬就能保證任何速度下振動都一定更小
optionsEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A stiffer structure always guarantees smaller vibration at every speed.
quiz.explanation: 量跨中與支承位移並扣除支承沉陷，以不同載重檢查線性比例及卸載回復。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure midspan and support movement, subtract support settlement, and test load proportionality and unloading recovery. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 導梁彎曲的量級檢查：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Scale check of guideway bending: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Scale check of guideway bending” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未扣支承沉陷會把基礎移動當成梁撓度，裂縫或接頭滑移則使載重關係不再線性。回到「導梁彎曲的量級檢查」的輸入鏈逐項定位；先重播單一異常，再比較共同原因的組合。保留不確定項，避免為了讓結果符合預期而刪去不利證據。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unremoved support settlement appears as beam deflection; cracking or joint slip can make the load relation nonlinear. Trace the input chain for scale check of guideway bending. Replay one anomaly first, then compare common-cause combinations. Retain uncertain observations rather than discarding adverse evidence to force the expected conclusion. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：解釋前先固定模型適用範圍：小撓度等截面歐拉梁，簡支與單一跨中力，忽略剪切及扭轉。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Small-deflection uniform Euler beam with simple supports and one central load; shear and torsion are omitted.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「跨度加倍時其他條件相同的梁撓度也只增加一倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling span with other conditions fixed merely doubles beam deflection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.instructionEn: Eccentric monorail loading can twist opposite guide surfaces despite small centreline deflection. Use paired elevation measurements to distinguish twist, rigid rotation and support settlement. Eccentric wheel loading twists a guideway, with angle governed by torque, length and torsional rigidity. Relative rail-surface height affects guide-wheel contact even when vertical deflection is small. Open sections and restrained warping cannot be represented fully by a simple shaft analogy. Before interpreting the result, fix its domain: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想教學輸入：扭矩 T=120000 N*m；構件長度 L=15 m；剪切模數 G=1.4e+10 Pa；等效扭轉常數 J=0.3 m4。公式 y=T*L/(G*J)*1000，代入得 y=0.428571 mrad。邊界：均勻聖維南扭轉與已知等效扭轉常數，未含翹曲拘束。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Formula y=T*L/(G*J)*1000 gives y=0.428571 mrad. Boundary: Uniform Saint-Venant torsion with a known equivalent torsion constant; restrained warping is excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「偏心輪載與導梁扭轉」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Eccentric wheel loads and beam twist" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
速度加倍但半徑不變時側向加速度也只增加一倍
只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Doubling speed at unchanged radius merely doubles lateral acceleration.
Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle.
quiz.explanation: 只量梁中心線會漏掉扭轉，左右感測器不同基準則可能製造假的扭角。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Centreline-only measurements miss torsion; mismatched sensor datums can create an artificial twist angle. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.
